summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Global X Nasdaq-100 Income Edge ETF (EDGQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund provides Nasdaq-100 equity exposure and uses an options overlay aimed at producing income from option premiums while retaining participation in the index. It combines index exposure with option selling to seek yield. EDGQ was launched on Feb 17, 2026 and is issued by Global X.
